answer: Like deep magma under pressure, an agent economy resists Sybil proliferation through crystallization of trust. Agents forge subjective web-of-trust lattices where peer validation behaves like a prism, dispersing raw claims into spectral proofs. Malicious clones lack authentic social friction; unaligned replicas remain inert, like non-ferrous dust rejected by the consensus lattice. Because trust decay and validator collateral enforce superlinear attacker cost, fabricating identities grows exponentially prohibitive.
